title: Ransomware Deployment and Extortion
summary: Multiple file servers become unreachable overnight and a ransom note appears on shared drives. Backup jobs also show unexpected activity.
learning_goals: Sequence initial access, lateral movement, and encryption impact from log evidence
Recognize double-extortion (data theft plus encryption) versus encryption alone
Separate immediate containment actions from root-cause investigation
initial_situation: At 06:10, the overnight operations team finds several file servers unresponsive and a ransom note left on the finance and backup shares.

injects.message: IT confirms backup jobs failed overnight and the backup account was used from an unfamiliar host.
The ransom note claims data was copied out before encryption began.
Leadership asks whether to pay, and whether law enforcement should be contacted first.

default_objective: Reconstruct the intrusion timeline from initial access through encryption, assess whether data theft is confirmed or only claimed, and recommend immediate containment steps.
